scope: Read-only review and four assertions in one isolated Chromium page; no application source edits or live execution by this reviewer

reproduction.method: Extract the exact current H151 waitForFunction callback in memory. Run it against explicitly synthetic mutable STORE/AUTH/DATA state. Intercept the sole local page request with in-memory HTML and abort any other request.

cases.name: Separate capture can differ from the successful wait
Primitive snapshot preserves the actual validated observation
Unresolved authentication is rejected by the actual callback
A context without the local writer is rejected by the actual callback

abc03.explanation: The run marked all 29 cases PASS, but H151 evidence captured synchronized=false for A and B after the earlier successful waits. The strict gate rejected this matrix; 29 PASS does not make it certified.

review.explanation: The callback returns a new object of observed primitive values only when the full predicate succeeds. jsonValue reads that retained observation. Added authentication, writer and ready checks narrow acceptance; immediate assertions preserve pending, synchronized and epoch requirements.

limits: This reproduction proves the separate-read timing mechanism. It does not identify whether an actual A/B transition in ABC03 came from a later poll or managed bootstrap.
The snapshot fixes the observation that satisfied the predicate; it does not guarantee the live state remains continuously unchanged or synchronized.
The final matrix case still compares terminal projections and device checkpoints with real authority. This local reproduction does not replace that case or the complete A/B/C run.
ABC03 remains rejected. A new complete run must match the changed certifier hash; this evidence does not certify ABC04.
